name: Saudi Currency
author: Mokhtar Bensaid

sections.description:
Saudi Arabia has recently introduced a new official currency symbol for the Saudi Riyal (SAR).
This plugin updates the Saudi Riyal currency symbol in WooCommerce stores to reflect the latest official changes.

Support

For any issues or feature requests, please email me at: [dev@mokhtarbensaid.com].
sections.installation:
1. Upload the saudi-currency folder to the /wp-content/plugins/ directory.
  2. Activate the plugin through the ‘Plugins’ menu in WordPress.
  3. The new Saudi Riyal symbol will automatically replace the old one in WooCommerce in the frontend but not in the WP Dashboard.
sections.faq:
What does this plugin do?

It updates the Saudi Riyal currency symbol (SAR) in WooCommerce to the latest officially recognized symbol.

Does this plugin require WooCommerce?

Yes, WooCommerce must be installed and activated for this plugin to work.

Will this plugin work with any WordPress theme?

Yes, it should work with any WooCommerce-compatible theme.
